catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class expresses one raw geometry_msgs/TwistStamped publication. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires duration_s and returns measured distance_m, heading_rad and stopped, while ROSTwistToPAT integrates the published twist over wall time and publishes no acknowledgement. The binding sets the six twist components; a rosbridge publication receipt is transmission evidence only.

No catalogue class carries a passive sensor_msgs/JointState observation. cap.motion.joint_position.v1 and cap.motion.joint_velocity.v1 command joints and require an acknowledged motion; this binding only reads the simulator's published joint names and positions.

No catalogue class observes a sensor_msgs/Range sample. The catalogue's read classes cover IMU, pressure, temperature, flow and optical measurements, not a ROS Range message with range, min_range and max_range.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the pinned UWSim package exposes a simulated vehicle twist topic but no acknowledged ROS stop, so a RosDriver cannot prove a safe state for its primary control. Last gate run 2026-11-05T09:18:32Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:3605c362a32a7f38b87bab43c64c486fa5daa83ebd64f239aaa6a410fb143d3c: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the device reports that its safe state was not reached, the latch stays engaged; G7 pass Native surface; G8 fail Protocol and surface with G8.CONFORMANCE (MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved, level CL1; failing required tests TCAP-003 and SAFE-028) and G8.TEST (TCAP-003 no observable effect; SAFE-028 e-stop receipt failed and safe_state_achieved=false); G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the clone advertises only the relative SpawnMarker service (uwsim/src/ROSSceneBuilder.cpp:34); it creates no stop, pause, reset or action server. The main loop has no pause flag and keeps stepping physics until the viewer closes or ros::ok() turns false (uwsim/src/main.cpp:195-244). stopROS calls ros::shutdown and is reached from the SIGTERM callback and after the loop (uwsim/src/main.cpp:31-50, 206-208, 246-247); that is process shutdown, not a ROS stop binding. ROSTwistToPAT subscribes to geometry_msgs/TwistStamped (uwsim/src/ROSInterface.cpp:150-154) and integrates the twist over wall-clock elapsed time (uwsim/src/ROSInterface.cpp:156-190), so a zero-twist publication is only the next unacknowledged input. A RosDriver safe_state/estop binding must be a source-backed service or fixed action, and no such endpoint exists; the package therefore declares no fabricated stop. A stock e-stop latches in software, RosBridge.safety_status reports safe_state.achieved=false because an effectful publication exists, and the server returns SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED while keeping the latch engaged. The same source gap makes TCAP-003 fail: the default cirs.xml scene has no PATToROSOdom output, so the publication has no pose or odometry readback, and the fake does not invent a state change to claim one.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver for the default cirs.xml scene. Primary control: x-cap.uji-ros-pkg.vehicle_twist.v1 publishes one geometry_msgs/TwistStamped to /g500/twist (uwsim/data/scenes/cirs.xml:359-362; type at uwsim/src/ROSInterface.cpp:153). Observations: sensor_msgs/JointState on /uwsim/joint_state (cirs.xml:346-349; publisher at ROSInterface.cpp:691-714) and sensor_msgs/Range on /uwsim/g500/range (cirs.xml:363-367; publisher at ROSInterface.cpp:941-960), each as a resource read and an explicit read-verb subscription capability. The package has no Python native class and no native.py; the clone is C++ ROS 1 nodes.

LIMITS: the six twist inputs have no numeric bound in the clone; each is Limit.operator_required with the source reason. site-limits.example.json is operator data and only supplies an example signed envelope (-0.5..0.5 m/s, -1.0..1.0 rad/s); it is not a device fact. There are no sourced velocity limits to cite and no limit is copied from a constructor default.

NOT COVERED: the /g500/pose and /uwsim/joint_state_command control inputs, the camera image and CameraInfo topics (/uwsim/camera1, /uwsim/camera1_info), the range camera, IMU, pressure/depth, DVL, GPS, multibeam LaserScan, force, echo, contact and TF outputs. The IMU and pressure topics are written as relative names g500/imu and g500/pressure in the scene XML; this package does not invent a resolved absolute spelling for them. The message named pressure carries a localized z translation, not a pressure in Pa (uwsim/src/PressureSensor.cpp:18-29), so it is not bound under a pressure class. The camera array is the fixed ROS Image/CompressedImage artifact path's primary output and is not implemented here.

FIDELITY: the fake is a ROS-free analytic recording transport at F0, not a recording of captured traffic: no UWSim, OSG, Bullet physics, scene or wall-clock loop; joint names, joint positions and range are placeholders (marked # placeholder in fake.py) and the twist publication is not integrated. No ROS graph, simulator, camera or hardware was run; driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null and the package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run ros-wave-c-147. No human reviewed or tested anything and no hardware run is claimed. The clone at 7f4a276c55f34524e418f56a6da401172943f886 was not modified; no network, pip install or upstream execution was used.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block (HELPER_MISSING): the gate still fails G6 and G8 (TCAP-003, SAFE-028), stable digest sha256:6b7e132edbc4d84819a7c4010b9a33503722eb6c707b40e3dbf09fe27cfa12ba unchanged; every scene topic, type, read path and the operator_required twist bounds were checked against cirs.xml and ROSInterface.cpp. Defects: the fact that SpawnMarker is the only ROS service in the clone was false (the underwater_vehicle_dynamics node advertises /dynamics/reset, which restores pose and velocity but keeps the thruster setpoint, dynamics.py:249-252, :323); safe_state treated a zero twist as the next input of a running integrator, while ROSTwistToPAT moves the vehicle once per message by its twist times the wall time since the previous message, zero for the first message and after a 1 s gap (ROSInterface.cpp:156-190), so isolated MHS publications move nothing; the dynamics launch's 1 kHz /g500/pose stream and keyboard thrusters, which compete with the twist, were not disclosed; and thirteen more facts said more than their lines. The reviewer corrected those fourteen facts, added eleven source facts, rewrote the docstring and safe_state and added one gap (driver.py), updated facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: UWSim simulation only; no hardware path (author's R2 kept). The vehicle keeps no velocity: each /g500/twist message moves it once, so motion needs a stream faster than 1 Hz and stops when messages stop, but nothing acknowledges that, and /g500/twist, /g500/pose (published every 1 ms by the shipped dynamics launch and applied directly) and /uwsim/joint_state_command stay open to any client. /dynamics/reset is a reset, not a stop.
